name: ad-angle-multiplier
title_zh: 一个卖点拆出 12 条不重样的广告角度
tagline_zh: 创意枯竭时喊它一声，同一款产品能换着法子讲给不同人群听。不是换形容词，是换诉求、换场景、换证据链。
tagline_en: When creative runs dry, it spins one product truth into fresh angles for different audiences — new hooks, new.
desc_en: Expand a core idea into multiple distinct ad angles. Trigger on "more ads", "creative testing", "scale campaigns".
why_zh: 它拆角度靠的是人群×诉求×证据链的矩阵，不是同义改写。给一个核心卖点，它按购买阶段和媒介语境切分。
why_en: It expands via audience×need×proof matrix, not synonym swaps. Feed one core truth, get variants sliced by funnel stage and media.
limit_zh: 只吃你给的那一个核心卖点，不负责验证真伪；产出是角度文案，不含视觉、落地页或受众定向包。
limit_en: Takes only the one core claim you feed it — won't fact-check. Output is angle copy only: no visuals, no landing pages, no targeting packs. Vague.
title_en: One core idea, 12 distinct ad angles
